notes: Temporal בְּ + infinitive construct recast as a finite clause: the preposition takes *when* (rule 52), the infinitive keeps *went forth* with the particle completing the going-out lexeme (rule 44), and מִן takes *out of* headed on *out* (rule 24).

לֹעֵז → *of strange language* is one participle's multi-word rendering; the *of* is inside the supplied phrase, not a rule-19 relation, since no second source nominal stands (rule 31). Head on *strange*; *language* was the competing head.
